The Rangers played 162 regular-season games in 2026 and 66 of them (41%) had no run in the first inning, the result an NRFI bet needs. They scored in the first in 30% of their games and allowed a first-inning run in 35%. Everything below is counted from the official line scores through September 27, 2026.
